notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello again everyone!

The early days have been going well as player counts have been increasing. Still need more people in our Community Discord so feel free to stop by! https://discord.gg/KEkyuUxuSy

We have a nice update for today with some requested features and fixes.


Click counter now saves on close and reopen of the game. (NOTE: It will not start saving the count until after you update unfortunately).
You can now change the background color in the options menu.
Can also change window border color in the options menu.
Fixed a bug with the options menu being jerky when opening and off-center on fullscreen.
Complete UI overhaul of options menu with scrolling. Will be more important as I add more features to the options menu.
Added the ability to make 2D avocados rotate as well, will make more sense when I implement the fruit ninja slicing animation to chop them up when you click. Or maybe it will make less sense... hard to tell :P


I am planning over the next few days to shift the drop system to be a little more diverse, consistent, and drop more frequently without over saturating the Steam market. We will see how it goes.

Until next time!

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 - 7/14/2024
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are enjoying the first couple of days of the games release! I have been collecting some feedback and am starting to implement changes in order of importance. This is the first patch to deal with some of the more critical issues I see with the game:


Added in-game drop notification when a drop happens. It shows a picture and info about the avocado that dropped and has a button to take you to the marketplace to sell it if you like!
Added an in-game Discord button to take you directly to the community server.
Fixed an error with the "Basic Avocado 3D" loading the wrong skin into the game.


The taskbar right click menu is bugged and reading the wrong title. This is turning out to be a tough bug to fix in this engine atm so I will have to do some digging for a fix.

I am keeping a close eye on reported drop rates by people to make sure that everything lines up and people are dropping the correct amount of avocados everyday. There are some bumps but nothing that can't be worked out over the next couple of days. I Hope everyone continues to enjoy the game! Look forward to more updates tomorrow!
